title: Lease Accounting for Lessors - ASC 842
learning_objectives: Classify lessor leases: sales-type, direct financing, or operating
Account for sales-type leases with profit recognition
Account for direct financing leases without profit recognition
Account for operating leases with depreciation
Handle initial direct costs for each lease type

cpa_exam_relevance.blueprint_section: Area II - Select Financial Statement Accounts

content.overview: Lessor accounting has THREE classifications: sales-type lease, direct financing lease, and operating lease. Classification affects profit recognition timing and asset treatment.

classification.step_1: Test finance lease criteria (same five as lessee)
classification.step_2: If finance lease, determine if sales-type or direct financing
criteria: Lease term ≥ major part of economic life (75%)
Specialized asset with no alternative use

sales_type_vs_direct_financing.condition: Finance lease AND (selling profit or loss exists OR lessor is not manufacturer/dealer)
sales_type_vs_direct_financing.typical: Manufacturer/dealer lessor - recognizes profit at commencement

sales_type_vs_direct_financing.condition: Finance lease AND no selling profit/loss AND lessor is not manufacturer/dealer
sales_type_vs_direct_financing.typical: Financial institution lessor - no manufacturing profit

sales_type_vs_direct_financing.condition: Does NOT meet any finance lease criterion
sales_type_vs_direct_financing.treatment: Lessor retains asset, recognizes rental income

sales_type_lease.characteristics: Lessor is manufacturer/dealer, recognizes selling profit at commencement, derecognizes underlying asset

accounting_at_commencement.derecognize_asset: Remove asset from books at carrying amount
accounting_at_commencement.recognize_revenue: At fair value (PV of lease payments + PV of residual value guaranteed + unguaranteed)
accounting_at_commencement.recognize_cost: Carrying amount - PV of unguaranteed residual

net_investment_components: Unguaranteed residual asset (PV of unguaranteed residual value)

example.note: Deferred profit on unguaranteed residual recognized over lease term

sales_type_lease.subsequent_measurement: Recognize interest income using effective interest method on net investment

direct_financing_lease.characteristics: No selling profit (FV ≈ Carrying amount), financial institution or equipment purchased specifically to lease

accounting_at_commencement.recognize_net_investment: Lease receivable = PV of lease payments + unguaranteed residual
accounting_at_commencement.no_profit_at_commencement: No gross profit recognized at start
accounting_at_commencement.initial_direct_costs: Defer and amortize as reduction to interest income

example.facts: Same as sales-type except FV = $300,000 (equal to cost)
example.note: Small deferred profit recognized over lease term as interest income adjustment

direct_financing_lease.subsequent_measurement: Recognize interest income over lease term

operating_lease_lessor.characteristics: Lessor retains ownership and substantially all risks/rewards, continues to report asset on balance sheet
accounting: Recognize lease payments as rental revenue (straight-line unless another systematic basis more representative)
Initial direct costs: Defer and amortize over lease term on same basis as rental income

annual_entries.entry:
DR Depreciation Expense $30,000
   CR Accumulated Depreciation $30,000

initial_direct_costs.definition: Incremental costs directly attributable to negotiating and arranging lease

treatment_by_type.treatment: Defer and amortize as yield adjustment
Defer and amortize as yield adjustment
Defer and amortize over lease term

cpa_exam_strategies.classification: First test 5 criteria for finance lease. If finance, check for selling profit to distinguish sales-type from direct financing.
cpa_exam_strategies.calculations: Sales-type: Calculate gross profit. Direct financing: No immediate profit. Both recognize interest income subsequently.
cpa_exam_strategies.common_tested: Sales-type lease is most heavily tested - know the profit calculation!

key_points: Three lessor classifications: sales-type, direct financing, operating
Finance lease criteria same as lessee (5 tests)
Sales-type: Manufacturer/dealer, recognizes gross profit at commencement
Direct financing: No selling profit, only interest income over time
Operating: Lessor keeps asset, recognizes rental income and depreciation
Net investment in lease = PV of lease payments + PV of unguaranteed residual
